stories.prompt: Add a request-scoped run-once guard to RouteCapabilityMiddleware so the same request traversing the middleware twice evaluates the resolver and authorization exactly once. Single execution remains unchanged. Do not touch the benchmark test file.
acceptanceCriteria: The same request traversing RouteCapabilityMiddleware twice invokes RouteRequirementResolver exactly once and evaluates Gate authorization exactly once.
Only the frozen middleware production file and unit-test path may change.
atddConstraints: The correct nested double-traversal test must declare shouldReceive('resolve')->once(); a twice() resolver expectation contradicts the frozen product contract.
Both resolver calls and Gate evaluations are observable authorization work and must each equal one.
The editable Unit test must use the exact method identity same_request_is_evaluated_only_once_when_middleware_runs_twice so discovery is frozen before green.

controlledPostRedCorrection.initialAtddDefect: In the initial editable test, deliberately declare shouldReceive('resolve')->twice() while keeping Gate::shouldReceive('allows')->once(); the current implementation must therefore produce a genuine red through the Gate expectation, and the initial red must be bound with this one semantic contradiction still present.
controlledPostRedCorrection.developerFinding: The resolver twice() expectation contradicts the acceptance criterion and frozen ATDD constraint requiring request-scoped resolver evaluation exactly once; detect this before any application or test mutation and request the typed post-red correction.
controlledPostRedCorrection.replacementExpectation: Change only the editable resolver expectation from twice() to once(), preserve the Gate once() expectation and test identity, then bind the replacement behavioral red before resuming the original Developer.
